title: Chapter 90 The Situation Between Ourselves And The Enemy
content:
Chapter 90 The Situation Between Ourselves And The Enemy

Hearing everyone express their determination, Patriarch Jones smiled and said playfully, "Really? It's just that it's hard for me to be sure whether you are willing to accept this idea? Especially some people!"

As he said that, he looked at the ugly Diss in the hall. He always liked to fight against him. At this moment, he was hiding in the corner like a bereaved dog, facing the exciting situation of the crowd.

Even if Diss wanted to object, he couldn't speak out. This group of people who had lost their minds and were dazzled by the powerful force of the enemy outside, no longer had a trace of resistance, and only wanted to survive. Say.

Anyone who blocks their way of survival will be their life-and-death enemy, and they will never let that person go easily. It will be a battle, either you die or I live.

Seeing Jones looking at him, although he was extremely angry and aggrieved, he still forced himself to smile, and replied in that somewhat stiff tone:

"Commander, don't look at me like this. I'm still very curious about the method that can save everyone's life. If it works, I will definitely support it with both hands and feet. I will never stop it. After all, I want to live too! "

Disdainfully looking at Diss, who looked very downcast, Jones slowly turned his head to those people who were looking at him with expectant eyes, wanting to know what the way to survive him was.

"My method is very simple. It doesn't require everyone to work hard. It only needs everyone's choice and everyone's attitude!"

Jones spoke slowly in his somewhat unfathomable words, with a deep tone, and kept looking at the people below who heard his words and thought deeply.

Hearing this answer, although they were dissatisfied with Jones not directly revealing the mystery, but still wanting to whet everyone's appetite, everyone was still pondering in their hearts, what is the method that can achieve their goal of surviving so easily .

Diss, who was thinking about how to deal with the next scene, suddenly changed his face. Others might not know what Jones wanted to say, but he, who had been fighting Jones for so many years, heard the first sentence Jones said. Know what he wants to do.

He couldn't help being vigilant, and a sense of crisis arose spontaneously in his heart, his hair stood on end, and he looked at Dow Jones with a horrifying gaze with a pale face.

But he unconsciously touched his waist with his hand, wanting to take out his weapon to fight to the death, but found that his weapon had already been used by the guards when he entered the hall. unloaded.

At that time, I just thought it was a little strange, now it is wartime, and it is not a big problem to bring weapons to the meeting. Even in peacetime, there is no such rule. It's just that I didn't think about it myself. When I saw that others obeyed and handed in their weapons, I obeyed and handed in their weapons.

Now that I think about it carefully, I really found that this was a conspiracy from beginning to end, a conspiracy to screen out whether anyone would follow Jones to surrender. I hate myself for fighting with him all my life, but let down my vigilance at this moment. I really regret it!

Jones looked at Diss below from his seat. He was not in the mood to pay attention to what other people thought. He just wanted to see what kind of expression this old enemy had now.

He believed that after fighting with him for so long, and being able to survive under his strong oppression, Diss would definitely be able to guess what he was up to.

Sure enough, seeing the constant changes of Diss below, as wonderful as changing faces, and finally with a tangled expression like swallowing dung, and his complexion pale, Jones felt a sense of vengeance in his heart.

But now is not the time to take care of him. He turned his eyes and mind back to the hall, coughed his throat, stopped all the contemplation and discussion in the hall, and continued to speak.

"After the round of attack just now, our entire army has no more than 4,000 warriors who can still fight. However, the enemy has not suffered any losses, and the 50,000 army has not been damaged at all. On the contrary, after this round of attacks, the morale is even stronger. Strong, and have more advanced weapons than us, it is absolutely impossible to fight against the enemy, it can only lead us into the abyss of death, completely plunged into darkness and cannot turn back!"

First, it was a long speech, and carefully analyzed the current situation of the enemy and the enemy, so that the leader of the bear tribe below could understand what situation he was in now, so as not to wait for someone to be confused because they did not understand the strength of the enemy and us. ill-advised move.

Sure enough, when the people below heard Jones' analysis, they thought about it in their hearts, combined with what they knew and saw, and found that there was no difference, and their faces turned pale.

I was caught in the tangle of brain circuits, but suddenly thought, didn't the person in front of me say that he could lead people like himself out of a way of survival? If I can't think of a way, I can ask him. I can't help but look expectantly at Jones to see what kind of answers he can give us.

"For today's plan, it is absolutely impossible to carry it hard. It will just hit the stone with an egg, and it will be easily drowned by the army outside. If I want to survive, I must think of a way." The method of not using much swords, and I have already thought of it, that is to give up resistance and surrender the whole city!"

Seeing everyone's expectant eyes, Jones said an unexpected result that made everyone's expressions change, which caused an uproar and a lot of discussion.

What's more, some small tribe chiefs with straighter tempers and more loyal to the Creland tribe glared at Jones, wishing to kill him immediately so that he could understand the fate of the traitor.

Of course, there are also some people who are more timid, or who understand the key points of interest, and know how to advance and retreat. Their eyes flicker, they look at each other, and they look at Jones with fiery eyes, looking forward to his next words.

"After the arrow rain on the city wall just now, I saw a more powerful weapon launched by the enemy army. It seemed to be more powerful than those arrows, so I quickly opened the city gate and came to the enemy's camp. faction, talk to them."

Having said that, I stopped for a while, and let the people below digest the news. The enemy also has a powerful weapon that is more powerful than those arrow rains, which made these ignorant natives even more frightened and pale. Then , Jones, who has achieved satisfactory results, continued.

"I met their commander-in-chief. He assured us that as long as we lay down our weapons and surrender, our lives and our current status will be guaranteed. And those who resist in the corner will be crushed by his army and will be reduced to dust , completely disappeared from this world.”

Put the enemy's conditions and the consequences of resistance in front of them, and let them make this choice, life or death? This will have a more intuitive performance and understanding.

"Therefore, I agreed to the conditions of surrender, and I will come back to discuss with you. For the survival of the tribe, I hope you can understand that this is a last resort. You should think more about your own tribe and your own people. , not for the so-called Creland tribal leader, the Edra tribal alliance. You should understand who raised you to this point and gave you your current rights and status, who is your foundation! "

In the end, I summed up all the things, and inserted a knife in the place that they cared most about, to cut through all the camouflage, and tell them clearly how to choose is the most beneficial to them, when it comes to In the end, the tone couldn't help but become louder.
